chipintelli_cwsl_init.message0: initialize CI13XX command-word self-learning timeout %1 ms
chipintelli_cwsl_init.tooltip: Initialize CWSL; select a command-word self-learning algorithm profile before compiling.

chipintelli_cwsl_end.tooltip: Stop receiving CWSL events and clear the event queue.

chipintelli_cwsl_learn.tooltip: Start asynchronous learning; command ID: 0–65535, group ID: 0–255. The command ID must exist in the active cmd_info resource; IDs 199–208 are reserved.

chipintelli_cwsl_cancel_learning.tooltip: Cancellation is accepted only before the LearningStarted event.

chipintelli_cwsl_erase_template.message0: erase learned %1 command ID %2 group ID %3
chipintelli_cwsl_erase_template.tooltip: Submit deletion of a learned template. Command ID: 0–65535; group ID: 0–255.

chipintelli_cwsl_erase_templates.tooltip: Submit a bulk learned-template deletion request.

chipintelli_cwsl_read_events.tooltip: Poll learning, deletion and recognition events in the current Arduino task.

chipintelli_cwsl_profile_enabled.tooltip: Check whether a CWSL algorithm profile was selected at compile time.

chipintelli_cwsl_available.tooltip: Check whether the CWSL event queue is non-empty.

chipintelli_cwsl_state.tooltip: Return 0 idle, 1 recognizing, 2 learning, 3 deleting, or 255 unavailable; return 255 before begin succeeds.

chipintelli_cwsl_state_value.tooltip: A constant for comparison with the current CWSL state.

chipintelli_cwsl_count.tooltip: Query learned-template usage and capacity; return -1 if begin has not succeeded.

chipintelli_cwsl_dropped_events.tooltip: Return the sum of dropped-event counts from the independent polling and callback queues.

chipintelli_cwsl_event_type.tooltip: Return the current event type code.

chipintelli_cwsl_event_word_type.tooltip: Return 0 command word, 1 wake word, or 2 all words.

chipintelli_cwsl_event_result.tooltip: Return the attempt result code from 0 to 6.

chipintelli_cwsl_event_command_id.tooltip: Return the command ID associated with the current event.

chipintelli_cwsl_event_group_id.tooltip: Recognition events return 65535 because the SDK does not report a group.

chipintelli_cwsl_event_type_value.tooltip: A constant from 1 to 9 for event-type comparisons.

chipintelli_cwsl_learn_result_value.tooltip: A constant from 0 to 6 for attempt-result comparisons.

chipintelli_cwsl_is_begun.tooltip: True if the latest begin succeeded and end has not been called.

chipintelli_cwsl_last_error.tooltip: Error code from the last initialization, learning, deletion or cancellation request. 0 means no error; it does not mean asynchronous completion.

chipintelli_cwsl_error_value.tooltip: Use to compare with the last operation error code.

chipintelli_cwsl_error_string.tooltip: Return the upstream library's English error description.

chipintelli_cwsl_state_name.tooltip: Return the current state name in English.

chipintelli_cwsl_event_name.tooltip: Read the current event's English name inside an event handler.

chipintelli_cwsl_pending_events.tooltip: Return the polling queue backlog, up to 15 events.

chipintelli_cwsl_clear_events.tooltip: Clear only the polling queue; does not cancel learning, deletion or callbacks.

chipintelli_cwsl_dropped_read_events.message0: number of dropped self-learning polling events
chipintelli_cwsl_dropped_read_events.tooltip: Return the polling queue's dropped-event count.

chipintelli_cwsl_dropped_callback_events.message0: number of dropped self-learning callback events
chipintelli_cwsl_dropped_callback_events.tooltip: Return the callback delivery failure count, independent of the polling queue.

chipintelli_cwsl_word_type_value.tooltip: Use to compare with the current event's word type.
